$comment: The JSON consumers that read a source's structured JSON directly — Extract Field, JSON Process and the list operators (filter-list here) — read the JSON output of the PIP a wire leaves from, on both engines (decided 2026-10-18). The source is the JSON-only worker of unit-json-outputs.json (type fixture-map: `json` first, `edl` second). `sources` are its states: `both`, a node holding both outputs (the editor's data; the server seeds its output from it), `arrayFirst`, a node whose first output is a list (its items must never reach the edl pip), and `edlOnly`, a job that wrote only `edl` (the server reads it live from `outputData` and seeded from `data`). Each case wires `pip` into a `consumer` with `data`; `text` is Extract Field's extractedText, `processedResult` JSON Process's, `items` filter-list's list. `fanOut` cases wire `pip` on an Each wire into an ordinary node: `items` is the list it fans out over (null: no fan-out) — a unit whose first output is a list fans out over it only from that pip. `edgeModes` cases wire `pip` with edge mode `mode` (an item pick, item:N, a Bundle, Selected) into fixture-echo's JSON input `plan`: `plan` is what lands in unitInputs.plan — a list-valued pip's items are picked or joined, never another output's.

cases.name: the edl pip into Extract Field reads the edit, not the first output
the json pip into Extract Field reads the first output
a job that wrote only edl: its edl pip into Extract Field reads it
a job that wrote only edl: its json pip into Extract Field reads nothing
the edl pip into JSON Process processes the edit
a job that wrote only edl: its json pip into JSON Process has no input
the edl pip into filter-list lists the edit (an object is one item)
a job that wrote only edl: its edl pip into filter-list lists it
a job that wrote only edl: its json pip into filter-list lists nothing
a first output that is a list never hands its items to the edl pip of filter-list
the json pip of a list-valued first output into filter-list lists its items

fanOut.name: the edl pip of a unit whose first output is a list does not fan out over that list
the json pip of a list-valued first output fans out over its items
an object on the pip is one item, so it does not fan out

edgeModes.name: a first output that is a list: an item wire on its edl pip reads the edit, never the list's first item
a first output that is a list: item:1 on its edl pip reads the edit, never the list's second item
a first output that is a list: a Bundle wire on its edl pip hands on the edit, never the list
an item wire on a list-valued json pip reads its first item
item:1 on a list-valued json pip reads its second item
a Bundle wire on a list-valued json pip joins its items
a Selected wire on a list-valued json pip hands on the whole output
an object pip is one item: item:1 on it reads the object
an object pip is one item: a Bundle wire on it hands on the object
